A young East Asian man (S1) with short neatly combed black hair, a clean-shaven face, a sand-colored overshirt, and a plain black crew-neck T-shirt stands behind a light-gray display table. One unmarked medium charcoal commuter backpack with a clean rectangular silhouette stands upright at center. A deep forest-green wall and a narrow oak shelf holding one plain beige ceramic object form the background. A locked eye-level medium half-body camera, soft key light, gentle fill, restrained amber rim light, realistic skin, and neutral exposure remain constant. S1 uses a clear, practical, medium-paced Mandarin voice. He begins with both hands relaxed beside the backpack, then raises his right open palm beside it. He looks into the lens and says once: <d>[Chinese] 这个双肩包外形很克制，比较适合通勤，不会显得过分运动。</d> His lips close, and his palm remains beside the backpack. No other person or human voice appears. No captions, subtitles, lower thirds, signs, screens, packaging, logos, brands, watermarks, letters, numbers, symbols, or readable text appear anywhere in frame.

overall_soundscape: Clear dry Mandarin speech, quiet treated studio room tone, and a restrained sleeve rustle beside the fabric backpack.
